blurb: Garrisons Lake Golf Club features a par 72, 18-hole layout measuring 7,060 yards from the back tees. The course was originally a 9-hole private club built in 1963, with the second nine added in 1966. The club is currently adding a new clubhouse expected to open later this summer.
